title: Automating trades from discord signal
author: Sharp-Ad827
selftext:
Im sure this has been asked/discussed before many times, but im a little new to this so here i go...I joined a discord server that gives trade signals (atistotle trades). I'm usually busy at my job so i cant really execute most of these trades from the discord. 

Is there any way I could have some kind of tool that reads the signals from discord and executes the trades on an exchange? Thanks

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
doable, with one catch: you can't add a bot to a server you don't run, so most people catch the calls through the server's own alerts or a forwarder, parse each one into ticker, strike, expiry and side, then send it through a broker API. parsing is the fragile bit, signal posts get edited and corrected after the fact, so run it on paper for a few weeks before money.

that paper half is the reason Quantradin exists. I built it as a place where an AI you connect places calls like these on fake money, options filled where you'd actually get filled. quantradin.com. are his calls options or shares?

replies.author: Sharp-Ad827
replies.body: He does both but majority of the calls are shares. Is there an existing "program" or "tool" that does what you described?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: shares make it a lot easier, a stock order is just ticker, side and size, and most broker APIs take that in one call. I haven't seen a ready-made one I'd trust with someone else's calls though. the ones I've looked at are a forwarder plus a small script, and the script is the part you end up owning anyway.

comments.author: hintheman
comments.body:
I also programmed paper trading bots that send alert messages to a Discord channel.  My bots live in [https://tastydaytraders.com/explore](https://tastydaytraders.com/explore)  This month is zero data and hence you need to use custom date range to see its performance.  The signals are in Discord channels and I do not know if there is 3rd party Discord Bot that forward the message.  Because Discord is a community with multiple users monitoring the channel and I think it is difficult to set up the Discord messages forwarding.  

Because of limitations in Discord,  I take my bots engines and created an options-scanner that provide on-demand trade suggestions on 11 options strategies and 1 futures trading suggestion in [https://tickersrank.ai/options-scanner](https://tickersrank.ai/options-scanner) The stock list comes from a ranker which is another bot.  All bots are built with Claude Code and hosted in OCI.
